mechanics.title: Repair
mechanics.description: Right-click a placed anvil with an iron ingot to repair it one damage stage. The ingot is consumed.

mechanics.title: Damage
mechanics.description: Right-click with obsidian to damage the anvil one stage, up to the most damaged state; it never breaks the block. The obsidian is not consumed.

vanilla_changes.change: Right-click with an iron ingot repairs one stage (consumes ingot); right-click with obsidian damages one stage (not consumed).

getting_started: Hold an iron ingot and right-click a damaged or chipped anvil.
name: Anvil Restoration
summary: Lets you repair or damage anvils that are placed in the world by right-clicking them. Iron ingots repair an anvil one stage; obsidian damages it one stage without breaking it.
